Japanese (RAW, Digital): https://e-hentai.org/g/1883799/6287486597/
Chinese (Translated, Digital): https://e-hentai.org/g/3184752/c9d90a8c70/

This gallery has another English translation that was released a few years ago, but it left much to be desired. The translation is very rough, and formatting is quite hard to look at, sometimes to the point that the text is almost illegible. On top of this, the translator took the liberty to add some of their own dialogue as well as omitting a good chunk of the original text. This is not to say anything against that translator, any translation is better than no translation (unless it's MTL, maybe), but the person who commissioned me simply wished to see this gallery translated in higher quality. The alternative English translation can be found here: https://e-hentai.org/g/2003722/91a3d8fb93/
